phrases.translation: 精密星历表；精确星历表

sentences.sentence: precise sales figures
sentences.translation: 准确的销售数据

sentences.sentence: It was difficult to get precise information.
sentences.translation: 很难得到确切的消息。

sentences.sentence: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
sentences.translation: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

sentences.sentence: He said that the deal should not be seen as a precursor to a merger.
sentences.translation: 他说这次交易不应该被看作是合并的前兆。

sentences.sentence: His troubles predated the recession.
sentences.translation: 他的麻烦早在经济衰退前就出现了。

sentences.sentence: We think of these strategies as having been in response to competition and in response to predation.
sentences.translation: 我们认为，它们的这种生存策略是为了应对生存竞争和其他生物的捕食。

sentences.sentence: The fastest land animal in the world, cheetahs once thrived in Africa and Asia, but lion predation haunts their young, and farms and ranching have reduced their habitat.
sentences.translation: 猎豹是陆地上速度最快的动物，曾在亚非大地上大量生长，但它们的幼兽常为狮子等捕食，栖息场所也因不断增加的农庄和牧场而缩减。

translations.translation: [动] 捕食者；[动] 食肉动物；掠夺者

sentences.sentence: With no natural predators on the island, the herd increased rapidly.
sentences.translation: 由于岛上没有天然食肉动物，牧群的数量迅速增加。

translations.translation: 掠夺的，掠夺成性的；食肉的；捕食生物的

phrases.translation: 掠夺性订价；掠夺性价格

sentences.sentence: predatory pricing
sentences.translation: 掠夺性定价

sentences.sentence: Kennedy’s predecessor as President was the war hero Dwight Eisenhower.
sentences.translation: 肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

sentences.sentence: the country’s economic predicament
sentences.translation: 该国的经济困境

sentences.sentence: She went to the office to explain her predicament .
sentences.translation: 她到办事处去说明她的难处。

sentences.sentence: The company’s expansion was predicated on the assumption that sales would rise.
sentences.translation: 公司的扩张是基于销售额会增长的假设。

sentences.sentence: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
sentences.translation: 销售额比预期低5%。

sentences.sentence: As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
sentences.translation: 正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

sentences.sentence: The data can be used to make useful economic predictions .
sentences.translation: 这些数据可用于进行有用的经济预测。

sentences.sentence: There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
sentences.translation: 教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

translations.translation: 主要的；卓越的；支配的；有力的；有影响的

sentences.sentence: Mandy's predominant emotion was confusion.
sentences.translation: 曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

sentences.sentence: The city’s population is predominantly Irish.
sentences.translation: 该城市的人口绝大多数是爱尔兰人。

sentences.sentence: In this type of case, the rights of the parent predominate.
sentences.translation: 像这样的案例，要首先考虑父母的权利。

sentences.sentence: Bombastic boasts—"We are positioned to become the preeminent provider of XYZ"—do not constitute a position.
sentences.translation: 言过其实的自夸——“我们定位于成为XYZ的卓越供应商”——并不能构建其地位。

sentences.sentence: And there is every reason to think America will once again regain its preeminent role as an American powerhouse.
sentences.translation: 我们也完全有理由相信，美国将再次赢得美利坚强国的卓越地位。

sentences.sentence: Sweden cars are extremely prestigious and reliable in the world for its preeminent safety performance, including SAAB.
sentences.translation: 瑞典制造的轿车在世界上最为有口皆碑的是其超群的安全性能，萨博也不例外。

sentences.sentence: Do you have a colour preference ?
sentences.translation: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

sentences.sentence: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
sentences.translation: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

sentences.sentence: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
sentences.translation: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

sentences.sentence: Many elderly people expressed a strong preference to live in their own homes.
sentences.translation: 许多老年人强烈表示喜欢住在自己的家里。

translations.translation: 优先的；选择的；特惠的；先取的

phrases.translation: 优先定位；择优定向；最佳取向

sentences.sentence: preferential credit terms for reliable borrowers
sentences.translation: 向可靠借款人提供的优惠信贷条件

sentences.sentence: The wall through Berlin was finally ruptured, prefiguring the reunification of Germany.
sentences.translation: 柏林墙终于倒塌了，预示着德国的重新统一。

translations.translation: 起飞前的；为起飞作准备的

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 106 单元

precise
音标：英 /prɪ'saɪs/  美 /prɪ'saɪs/
adj. 精确的；明确的；严格的
短语：to be precise — 确切地讲
短语：to be more precise — 更确切地说
短语：precise information — 精确资料
短语：precise instrument — 精密仪器
短语：at the precise moment — 恰恰在那个时刻
短语：precise alignment — 精密准直
短语：precise ephemeris — 精密星历表；精确星历表
短语：precise registration — 精密对准
例句：precise sales figures
准确的销售数据
例句：It was difficult to get precise information.
很难得到确切的消息。
例句：‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
“她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

precursor
音标：英 /prɪ'kɜːsə/  美 /pri'kɝsɚ/
n. 先驱，前导
短语：precursor chemicals — 易制毒化学品
例句：He said that the deal should not be seen as a precursor to a merger.
他说这次交易不应该被看作是合并的前兆。

predate
音标：英 /priː'deɪt/  美 /pri'det/
v. 在日期上早于（先于）
例句：His troubles predated the recession.
他的麻烦早在经济衰退前就出现了。

predation
音标：英 /prɪ'deɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /prɪ'deʃən/
n. 捕食；掠夺
例句：We think of these strategies as having been in response to competition and in response to predation.
我们认为，它们的这种生存策略是为了应对生存竞争和其他生物的捕食。
例句：The fastest land animal in the world, cheetahs once thrived in Africa and Asia, but lion predation haunts their young, and farms and ranching have reduced their habitat.
猎豹是陆地上速度最快的动物，曾在亚非大地上大量生长，但它们的幼兽常为狮子等捕食，栖息场所也因不断增加的农庄和牧场而缩减。

predator
音标：英 /'predətə/  美 /'prɛdətɚ/
n. [动] 捕食者；[动] 食肉动物；掠夺者
例句：With no natural predators on the island, the herd increased rapidly.
由于岛上没有天然食肉动物，牧群的数量迅速增加。

predatory
音标：英 /'predət(ə)rɪ/  美 /'prɛdətɔri/
adj. 掠夺的，掠夺成性的；食肉的；捕食生物的
短语：predatory pricing — 掠夺性订价；掠夺性价格
例句：predatory pricing
掠夺性定价

predecessor
音标：英 /'priːdɪsesə/  美 /'prɛdəsɛsɚ/
n. 前任，前辈
短语：predecessor company — 被接管公司
例句：Kennedy’s predecessor as President was the war hero Dwight Eisenhower.
肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

predicament
音标：英 /prɪ'dɪkəm(ə)nt/  美 /prɪ'dɪkəmənt/
n. 窘况，困境；状态
例句：the country’s economic predicament
该国的经济困境
例句：She went to the office to explain her predicament .
她到办事处去说明她的难处。

predicate
音标：英 /'predɪkət/  美 /'prɛdɪkət/
v. 断定为…；使…基于
n. 谓语，述语
adj. 谓语的；述语的
短语：(grammatical) predicate — （语法）谓语
短语：predicate logic — 谓词逻辑
短语：predicate verb — 谓语动词
短语：predicate calculus — 谓词演算
例句：The company’s expansion was predicated on the assumption that sales would rise.
公司的扩张是基于销售额会增长的假设。

predict
音标：英 /prɪ'dɪkt/  美 /prɪ'dɪkt/
v. 预报，预言；预知
例句：Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
销售额比预期低5%。
例句：As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

prediction
音标：英 /prɪ'dɪkʃ(ə)n/  美 /prɪ'dɪkʃən/
n. 预报；预言
短语：prediction model — 预测模型；推算模型
短语：earthquake prediction — 地震预报
短语：prediction error — n. 预测误差
短语：prediction algorithm — 预测算法
短语：linear prediction — 线性预测；线性预报
短语：weather prediction — 天气预报
短语：reliability prediction — [经]可靠性预计
短语：failure prediction — [计]失效预测，故障预测
例句：The data can be used to make useful economic predictions .
这些数据可用于进行有用的经济预测。

predisposition
音标：英 /priːdɪspə'zɪʃn/  美 /'pridɪspə'zɪʃən/
n. 倾向；素质；易染病体质
短语：genetic predisposition — 遗传素质
例句：There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

predominant
音标：英 /prɪ'dɒmɪnənt/  美 /prɪ'dɑmənənt/
adj. 主要的；卓越的；支配的；有力的；有影响的
例句：Mandy's predominant emotion was confusion.
曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

predominantly
音标：英 /prɪ'dɒmɪnəntlɪ/  美 /prɪ'dɑmɪnəntli/
adv. 主要地；显著地
例句：The city’s population is predominantly Irish.
该城市的人口绝大多数是爱尔兰人。

predominate
音标：英 /prɪ'dɒmɪneɪt/  美 /prɪ'dɑmə'net/
v. 支配，主宰；在…中占优势
短语：predominate over — 统治，支配；占优势
例句：In this type of case, the rights of the parent predominate.
像这样的案例，要首先考虑父母的权利。

preeminent
音标：英 /prɪ'emɪnənt/  美 /pri'ɛmɪnənt/
adj. 卓越的；超群的
例句：Bombastic boasts—"We are positioned to become the preeminent provider of XYZ"—do not constitute a position.
言过其实的自夸——“我们定位于成为XYZ的卓越供应商”——并不能构建其地位。
例句：And there is every reason to think America will once again regain its preeminent role as an American powerhouse.
我们也完全有理由相信，美国将再次赢得美利坚强国的卓越地位。
例句：Sweden cars are extremely prestigious and reliable in the world for its preeminent safety performance, including SAAB.
瑞典制造的轿车在世界上最为有口皆碑的是其超群的安全性能，萨博也不例外。

preference
音标：英 /'pref(ə)r(ə)ns/  美 /'prɛfrəns/
n. 偏爱，倾向；优先权
短语：preference for — 偏爱…
短语：preference to sth — 优先
短语：tax preference — 税收优惠
短语：personal preference — 个人喜好
短语：in preference to — 优先于……
短语：consumer preference — 消费者偏好，消费偏爱
短语：by preference — 最好，首先
短语：sexual preference — 性取向；性偏好；性爱好
短语：preference share — 优先股；红利先取股
短语：time preference — 时间的优先选择
短语：color preference — 色彩的嗜好；颜色爱好
短语：margin of preference — [经]优惠幅度；[经]优惠差额
短语：liquidity preference — [经]流动性偏好
例句：Do you have a colour preference ?
你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？
例句：Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。
例句：The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。
例句：Many elderly people expressed a strong preference to live in their own homes.
许多老年人强烈表示喜欢住在自己的家里。

preferential
音标：英 /,prefə'renʃ(ə)l/  美 /,prɛfə'rɛnʃl/
adj. 优先的；选择的；特惠的；先取的
短语：preferential price — 优惠价，照顾价格
短语：preferential treatment — 优待；特惠待遇
短语：preferential policy — 优惠政策；倾斜政策
短语：preferential trade — 特惠贸易
短语：preferential orientation — 优先定位；择优定向；最佳取向
短语：preferential adsorption — 选择性吸附
例句：preferential credit terms for reliable borrowers
向可靠借款人提供的优惠信贷条件

prefigure
音标：英 /priː'fɪgə/  美 /pri'fɪɡjʊr/
v. 预示；预想
例句：The wall through Berlin was finally ruptured, prefiguring the reunification of Germany.
柏林墙终于倒塌了，预示着德国的重新统一。

preflight
音标：英 /priː'flaɪt/  美 /,pri:'flait/
adj. 起飞前的；为起飞作准备的
